title: Degree of the odd coordinate part
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb{R}$ have Fourier degree at most $k+1$, where $k$ is a natural number. Fixing the first coordinate at $1$ and at $-1$ gives two functions on $\{-1,1\}^n$; their difference divided by $2$ has Fourier degree at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k+1$
